notes: Modified cash basis (cash). Governmental funds: pp6-7 Total column. Beginning cash = beginning fund balance 2,464,337 (p7), which equals cash incl. county treasurer cash (2024 total assets p4); ending cash 2,762,055 from p4 total assets. Taxes 448,802 split per fund schedules: property tax 217,246+91,239+8,713+6,468; motor vehicle 44,213; PPD 5% 60,189+1,679; township 19,055 (sums to 448,802). State revenues 391,329 (p6) split per fund schedules (attempt 3): homestead exemption 12,810+6,440+508 = 19,758; property tax credit 26,668+1,740+750 = 29,158; prorate motor vehicle 710+15 = 725; Street motor vehicle fees 15,736; remainder state aid 325,952 = municipal equalization 89,964 + highway allocation 234,103 + TIF state sources 1,885 (General 130,152 p18 + Street 258,019 p21 + Debt Service 1,273 p26 + TIF 1,885 p30 = 391,329). Governmental 'Other' 639,006 split by fund schedules: General 502,457 (PPD lease, rentals, franchise/occupation, lot sales, other; p18), Street 3,496 (p21), LB 840 110,117 (p24), nonmajor 22,936 (CDBG reuse 14,733 p25, Economic Development 4,643 p27, Library donations 3,560 p23). Business-type from proprietary statement of revenues, expenses (pp11-12) total column; measure is net position (cash-basis statement rolls net position, which reconciles: 3,588,522 + 884,707 - 807,206 + 11,680 + 129,675 = 3,807,378); capital contributions - grants 129,675 as other_financing, transfers in 11,680 as transfers_net. Business-type reported totals computed as operating + nonoperating (interest expense counted as disbursement). Business-type spending by cost type (function utilities); purchased garbage hauling as contract services, miscellaneous operating as other. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), Total column (kept: it includes capital assets and debt, so the governmental funds statement p4 totals do not equal it). Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp18-20); the by-department schedule (pp31-32), combined all-funds budget schedule (pp15-17) and nonmajor combining schedule (p33) duplicate these and are omitted; ARPA fund (p29) is blank for 2025; proprietary fund detail by fund (water/sewer/sanitation, pp11-12) not repeated in detail. Cash flow statement for proprietary funds not recorded (cash basis). Business-type detail: the utility lines (Sewer/Water/Sanitation charges; Solid Waste, Wastewater, Water operating and capital) of the combined all-fund-types budget schedule (pp15-17) are recorded in detail; its debt service, loan proceeds, lease and other lines and its totals mix governmental and utility funds, so no business-type total entry was added.
